protocol.domain: square [-1,1]^2 minus a centred regular polygon hole

boundary_conditions.walls_velocity: u = v = 0 on both the outer square and the inner polygon
boundary_conditions.temperature: T = 1 on the inner polygon, T = 0 on the outer square

sign_convention.convention: y upward; buoyancy term +rho*g_beta*(T-T_ref) in the y-momentum equation
sign_convention.source_evidence: paper/main.tex modelling assumptions; docs/P1_热场NS_PINN设计.md residual definitions; data boundary T=1 inner/T=0 outer; data velocity ~0 on all walls

detail.meaning: pressure enters only through its gradient
detail.gauge: mass-penalty zero-mean: add eps*integral(p*q); eps must be reported with true constraint div(u)=-eps*p and sensitivity; not exact gauge
detail.gauge_alternative: fixed reference DOF is allowed by the protocol but was replaced after an environment-specific BC issue; the mass penalty is an explicit gauge choice, not a physical force
